description.value:
You've learned to seize a rival forcecaster's knowledge mid-cast. When a hostile creature casts a force power targeting a friendly creature within the range of your Critical Analysis, you may use your reaction to make that friendly creature your Critical Analysis target, forcing the caster to attempt a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw (your choice) against your universal force save DC. On a success, the power proceeds normally.

On a failure, the power's effect is negated entirely, and if the power is 1st level or higher and within your casting capability, you steal knowledge of it: for the next 8 hours you know that power and can cast it using your own force points, while the original caster is barred from casting it again until those 8 hours pass.

You must finish a long rest before using this feature again.
